description: This file contains unit tests for the PyTorch Dynamo export functionality, including tests for graph export, shape control flow, constant assumptions, and various edge cases involving tensors, modules, and control flow constructs.

classes.name: ExportTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for verifying the correctness and robustness of the Dynamo export functionality, including shape control flow, constants optimization, and graph serialization.

classes.name: ExportTests
